description: The Black Firm LLC is a Black-owned metro Atlanta law firm. Practice areas include business law, wills and trusts, estate planning, probate and guardianship, and personal injury.

name: Goodr
tagline: Atlanta-based food waste and hunger-relief technology platform.
description: Goodr is a Black woman-owned, Atlanta-based technology and logistics company that uses an app-based platform to redirect surplus food from businesses to people experiencing food insecurity. It operates as a certified B Corporation.

name: InterSearchMedia
tagline: Black-owned, data-driven digital marketing agency serving Atlanta.
description: InterSearchMedia is a Black-owned digital marketing agency providing SEO, paid media, social media marketing, programmatic advertising, web analytics, and digital PR services.

name: The Kool Source
tagline: Black-owned Atlanta digital marketing agency for SEO, ads, and social.
description: The Kool Source is a Black-owned, full-service digital marketing agency in Atlanta offering SEO, pay-per-click and paid social advertising, social media management, web design, and branding services.

name: Liquid Soul
tagline: Atlanta multicultural lifestyle and entertainment marketing agency.
description: Liquid Soul is an Atlanta-based, Black-owned multicultural marketing and advertising agency specializing in culture-driven campaigns for film, television, sports, and entertainment brands.

name: PRecise Communications
tagline: African American and woman-owned PR agency for multicultural consumers.
description: PRecise Communications is an Atlanta-based, NMSDC-certified multicultural public relations and marketing agency. Services include media relations, digital marketing, experiential engagements, and bilingual media training.

name: FourStage Branding
tagline: Full-suite Black-owned branding and marketing agency in Atlanta.
description: FourStage Branding is a Black-owned, full-suite branding and marketing agency in Atlanta and a member of the Atlanta Black Chambers. Services include brand strategy, design, website development, and marketing.

name: Think and Ink Grant Consulting
tagline: Black woman-owned grant writing and consulting firm in Atlanta.
description: Think and Ink Grant Consulting is a Black-owned, woman-owned grant writing and consulting firm in Atlanta providing grant writing, grant strategy, and consulting services for nonprofits and organizations. It is a Certified B Corporation.
address_line_1: 309 East Paces Ferry Rd NE Ste 400

name: Qtalent Solutions
tagline: Black woman-owned staffing and HR consulting firm in metro Atlanta.
description: Qtalent Solutions is a Black woman-owned, MBE/WOSB-certified staffing and HR consulting firm in metro Atlanta offering full-cycle recruiting, executive and technical search, and workforce development.

name: XEC Solutions
tagline: Black-owned HR, executive search, and recruiting firm in Atlanta.
description: XEC Solutions is a Black-owned HR and staffing consultancy in Atlanta specializing in executive search, diverse HR solutions, and staff augmentation across industries including IT, healthcare, and aerospace.

name: BRANDPRENUER
tagline: Black-owned brand photography studio for headshots and executive portraits.
description: BRANDPRENUER is a Black-owned brand and headshot photography studio in Atlanta located within the Russell Innovation Center for Entrepreneurs, specializing in professional headshots, executive portraits, group, and event photography.

name: RefreshCoAtl
tagline: Black-owned Atlanta cleaning service with fast online booking.
description: RefreshCoAtl is a Black-owned residential cleaning service in Atlanta. Customers can book a cleaning online and choose between a full deep clean or a single room.

name: The Construction Kings
tagline: Black-owned Atlanta new and luxury construction and redevelopment company.
description: The Construction Kings is a Black-owned construction and redevelopment company in the Atlanta area focused on new and luxury home construction, also teaching aspiring builders through educational programs.

name: H.J. Russell & Company
tagline: One of the largest African American-owned construction and program management firms.
description: H.J. Russell & Company is an Atlanta-headquartered, African American-owned firm offering construction management, program management, real estate development, and property management.

name: Conley Realty Group
tagline: Black-owned Atlanta real estate brokerage, property management, and development firm.
description: Conley Realty Group is a Black-owned, minority-owned real estate company serving the Atlanta metropolitan area, providing real estate brokerage, property management, development, and consulting services.

name: Events by Mesita
tagline: Black woman-owned Atlanta luxury event planning and floral design company.
description: Events by Mesita is a Black woman-owned event planning and floral design company in Atlanta producing weddings, corporate events, and social celebrations, along with floral design and party rentals.

name: Fender Bender's Autobody & Collision Repair
tagline: Black-owned collision repair and auto body shop serving the Atlanta metro area.
description: Fender Bender's Autobody & Collision Repair is a Black-owned auto body shop serving the Atlanta metro area from Jonesboro, GA. Services include collision repair, paint jobs, panel and frame repair, dent removal, and wheel alignment.

name: Bomb Biscuit Co.
tagline: Black woman-owned Southern restaurant known for from-scratch biscuits and brunch
description: Bomb Biscuit Co. is a Black-owned Southern restaurant serving biscuits, breakfast sandwiches, fried chicken, and brunch items. It is recognized in the MICHELIN Guide as a Bib Gourmand restaurant.

name: Black Coffee ATL
tagline: Black-owned specialty coffee shop in Atlanta
description: Black Coffee ATL is a Black-owned specialty coffee shop in Atlanta serving espresso drinks, matcha, and house-made syrups, with locations including Auburn Avenue and the Westside Beltline.

name: Soul Vegetarian
tagline: Atlanta's longstanding Black-owned vegan restaurant in the West End
description: Soul Vegetarian is a Black-owned, fully vegan restaurant in Atlanta's West End, widely credited with helping pioneer the city's Black vegan dining scene.

name: JB's Record Lounge
tagline: Black-owned West End record store with live DJ sets and jazz sessions
description: JB's Record Lounge is a Black-owned independent record store in Atlanta's West End offering vinyl, turntables, and programming such as live DJ sets and jazz sessions.

name: Crates ATL
tagline: Black-owned South Downtown vinyl boutique highlighting Black artists
description: Crates ATL is a Black-owned record store in South Downtown Atlanta offering new and vintage vinyl, turntables, and speakers with a focus on Black artists and genres like jazz, hip-hop, funk, and soul.

name: Mogul Grooming Co.
tagline: Black-owned barbershop and grooming destination in Sweet Auburn
description: Mogul Grooming Co. is a Black-owned barbershop and men's grooming destination in Atlanta's historic Sweet Auburn district, offering haircuts and beard and mustache services.

name: T. Dallas Smith & Company
tagline: One of the largest Black-owned commercial real estate firms, based in Atlanta
description: T. Dallas Smith & Company is a Black-owned commercial real estate firm based in Atlanta, specializing in tenant and buyer representation for corporate users of office, industrial, and land.

name: Johnson STEM Activity Center
tagline: Atlanta STEM center founded by inventor Dr. Lonnie Johnson
description: The Johnson STEM Activity Center is an Atlanta nonprofit founded by inventor and former NASA scientist Dr. Lonnie Johnson, offering youth programs in robotics, eSports, and computer programming.

name: 100 Black Men of Atlanta, Inc.
tagline: Atlanta nonprofit mentoring and supporting African-American youth
description: 100 Black Men of Atlanta, Inc. is a Black-led civic nonprofit supporting educational and economic opportunities for African-American youth in Atlanta, including school mentorship programs.

tagline: Atlanta's home of BBQ, seafood, and soul food since 1983.
description: A metro-Atlanta institution since 1983, This Is It! BBQ & Seafood serves a signature mix of barbecue, fried seafood, and Southern sides across its Black-owned family of restaurants — a go-to for soul food done right.
name: This Is It! BBQ & Seafood

tagline: A 30-year Black family-owned soul food staple on MLK Drive.
description: Family-owned and operated for over three decades, Mr. Everything Cafe is one of Atlanta's longest-running Black-owned restaurants. Known for hearty sandwiches, rice bowls, and 'Healthy Choice' plates served just west of downtown on Martin Luther King Jr. Drive.
address_line_1: 882 Martin Luther King Jr Dr SW
name: Mr. Everything Cafe

tagline: Voted Atlanta's #1 breakfast — all-day brunch in College Park.
description: A Black-owned collaboration between restaurateur Lorenzo Wyche and the Smalls brothers of Virgil's Gullah Kitchen, The Breakfast Boys serves elevated all-day breakfast and brunch in Downtown College Park — voted the #1 breakfast restaurant in Atlanta.
name: The Breakfast Boys

tagline: Bold, authentic Caribbean jerk and BBQ in Stone Mountain.
description: Juci Jerk brings bold, authentic Caribbean BBQ to metro Atlanta — jerk chicken, oxtail, and island classics from a Black-owned kitchen that has built a loyal following across its Stone Mountain and Marietta locations.
name: Juci Jerk

tagline: Hip-hop-inspired artisan pizza on Metropolitan Parkway.
description: Founded by Derrick Moore, Clinton Gray, and Emanuel Reed, Slim & Husky's is a Black-owned pizza beeria serving build-your-own artisan pies with a hip-hop and R&B-inspired vibe. Its Metropolitan Parkway shop anchors several Atlanta-area locations.
name: Slim & Husky's Pizza Beeria
